# Monsters of the Gates on film (SPEC §60), reel shooters of 1: rivet_gunner, crypt_archer, hollow_tender, thorn_archer, security_unit, abyss_watcher.
# Each is filmed close from the side with the clip recorder: standing, closing on a dummy and striking it (its string
# of blows, the closing circle of each), acting each of its moves (its own shots in flight, its matter, its opening),
# and dying. Clips: run-autopilot/clips/<id>_<idle|fight|m0..|death>; sheets: python3 -I tools/ascent/clip.py <clip>.
# GENERATED by `python3 tools/art/specs/gate_monsters.py film`: edit that, not this.

waitworld

cmd forceload add -32 -32 32 48
gui 0
cmd gamerule send_command_feedback false
cmd gamerule awaken:fauna_spawning false
cmd gamerule spawn_mobs false
cmd weather clear 1000000
cmd time set 6000
cmd awaken admin awaken
wait 200
cmd awaken powers starter 1
wait 20
screen close
camera first
hud off
cmd effect give @s minecraft:resistance infinite 4 true
cmd effect give @s minecraft:regeneration infinite 4 true

cmd effect give @s minecraft:night_vision infinite 0 true
info
cmd tp @s 0.5 201 0.5 0 0
wait 100
cmd fill -24 200 -16 24 200 40 minecraft:smooth_stone
